lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots extending from the posterior margin of the fifth gill slit toward the caudal peduncle, with the highest density in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity creating a grid-like alignment with the horizontal spot rows, most discernible in the anterior section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally along the mid-flank, characterized by a sharp transition in pixel intensity and texture between the maculated dorsal region and the unpatterned ventral area.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: An irregular distribution of approximately 10 high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily on the lower half and posterior margin of the first dorsal fin's lateral silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small V-shaped indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple attached elongated ectoparasites (remoras) on the ventral surface and posterior mid-flank.
